reading:
EdgeConneX was founded in 2009 and is headquartered at 2201 Cooperative Way in Herndon, Virginia, with regional headquarters in Schiphol-Rijk, Netherlands for EMEA and Singapore for Asia-Pacific. EQT Infrastructure, the Stockholm-based investment firm, acquired the company in 2020, providing capital for expansion into land and power acquisition.

The company's own site describes a portfolio of more than 90 facilities built or in development across five regions, Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, North America, and South America, with a stated capacity range from 40 kilowatts up to 500 megawatts or more per project, spanning small edge deployments to hyperscale campuses. Notable ventures include AdaniConneX, a joint venture in India, a strategic investment in China-based Chayora, and recent expansion into Barcelona, Brussels, Israel, Indonesia, and Japan.

The registry here tracks 8 EdgeConneX facilities across five states, Arizona, California, Illinois, Michigan, and Oregon. EdgeConneX's stated 40 kilowatt to 500 megawatt project range is the widest capacity span disclosed by any operator recorded in this registry so far, reflecting a business model built around edge and regional deployments as well as large hyperscale campuses, a dual positioning distinct from the single-scale models of pure hyperscaler operators like AWS or pure metro-colocation operators like Equinix.
